summary: Added a published-blog-count drift check to scripts/audit-content.mjs (npm run content-audit). It parses the '**Published:** N blog posts' marker in docs/editorial-backlog.md and fails closed when that count does not match the actual src/content/blog collection count, or when the marker is missing/unparseable, so the drift PP-RELAY-025 hand-corrected (53 vs 60) cannot silently recur. No new dependency or standalone script; integrated into the existing CI-run content-audit check.
verification: npm run content-audit passes on normal repo state (60 blog posts, 25 lessons valid)

Deliberately simulated a documented-count mismatch (backlog marker 60 -> 61, not committed): content-audit failed with 'Documented published blog count (61) does not match actual src/content/blog count (60)' and non-zero exit
Restored docs/editorial-backlog.md from the simulated edit and re-ran npm run content-audit to confirm it passes again before commit
git status/diff confirmed no unintended file changes and no leftover simulated mismatch

tools_or_methods: grep/read of scripts/audit-content.mjs and docs/editorial-backlog.md to find the smallest integration point and a stable marker line
direct script edit adding checkPublishedCountDrift() and wiring it into the existing errors array
shell-based simulated mismatch test with restoration from a temp backup before commit
